subcategory_text: Develop processes and technical controls to identify, classify, securely handle, retain, and dispose of data.
implementation_examples: IG1: Identify and classify sensitive data; maintain a data inventory
IG2: Apply access controls to sensitive data; encrypt data at rest
IG3: Deploy DLP; segment data based on classification
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data is identified and classified.
Determine whether sensitive data is protected.
